action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Dawid Golunski discovered that Swift Mailer did not properly sanitize
e-mail addresses in the mail transport. A remote attacker could possibly
use this issue to pass extra parameters to the mail command and execute
arbitrary code.
isummary:
Swift Mailer could be made to run programs if it received specially crafted
input.
title: Swift Mailer vulnerability
